title: UPI: Anatomy of a Payment Transaction
summary: This article provides a deep technical dive into how UPI (Unified Payments Interface) processes payment transactions, covering the architecture, flow, and components involved from transaction initiation to settlement.
problem_solved: Enables instant, seamless inter-bank money transfers in India without requiring users to know beneficiary bank details.
why_valuable: UPI has revolutionized digital payments in India with billions of transactions processed, and understanding its architecture provides insights into building scalable real-time payment systems.
